# platine-php/cache

> 标签: application, cache, development, framework, php, platine, website

## 简介

Platine Cache is the implementation of PSR 16 simple cache

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 8；已收录于 php-v8。

- 官网：https://packagist.org/packages/platine-php%2Fcache
- 源码仓库：https://github.com/platine-php/cache.git
- Packagist 页面：https://packagist.org/packages/platine-php%2Fcache
